heroHeadline: Kast Fires Sports Minister Over Vehicle Scandal, Runs 'Operación Cancerbero' Prison Transfer as Copper Hits New Record
heroSubtitle: President José Antonio Kast accepted Sports Minister Natalia Duco's resignation on August 13 after a Contraloría complaint over misuse of a government vehicle, the same day Gendarmería carried out 'Operación Cancerbero' — transferring nearly 300 high-risk inmates to a new Bukele-style maximum-security prison in Talca. A White House report named Chile among countries used by China to evade US tariffs (Aug 13), and the Chamber of Deputies voted 102-14-12 to extend the Macrozona Sur state of exception another 30 days (Aug 18). Pollsters diverged sharply on Kast's standing: Cadem put approval at 41% with 93% backing Plan Cancerbero, while Criteria held it flat at 35% with disapproval climbing to 55%. Copper set a new all-time record of US$6.736/lb on the LME (Aug 17), extending the fiscal windfall from the Aug 6 record, as Kast also decreed a preventive weather emergency from Arica to Coquimbo (Aug 10).
footerNote: Data sourced from official Chilean government records (Biblioteca del Congreso, Banco Central, SERVEL), Rettig and Valech commissions, IACHR, CIPER Chile, and major international outlets.
